channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Ocarina of Time remake scores 96 on Metacritic, the best of 2026
item.description: Nintendo's Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time launches November 5 with a 96 Metascore, the highest-rated game of the year so far.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 opens with over ₹104 crore in advance sales
item.description: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1, with Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash, opens November 5 after one of India's biggest pre-sale runs of the year.

item.title: GTA VI pre-loads open November 10 and the game needs 212GB
item.description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI can be pre-loaded from November 10 ahead of its November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero is tracking for a $30 million US opening
item.description: Toho's sequel to Godzilla Minus One is projected to open around $30 million in North America this weekend, ahead of The Cat in the Hat.

item.title: Voters reject AI data centers in nearly every local ballot measure
item.description: Data center opponents won virtually all of more than 40 local ballot measures across 10 US states in Tuesday's elections, early results show.

item.title: Apple is reported to be cutting how much its engineers can spend on AI
item.description: Bloomberg reports Apple cut its engineers' daily AI spending cap from $300 to $200, with some allowances set to fall to $100.

item.title: Moonshot publishes the open weights for its 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3.1 Pro
item.description: Moonshot AI released full weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro on Hugging Face, where it topped the trending list.

item.title: Qualcomm shares fall as phone chip sales drop 26%
item.description: Qualcomm's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $10.44 billion slightly missed forecasts, and its stock fell over 6% after hours.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may be close to self-improving AI
item.description: Anthropic's amended S-1 says future models may soon meet its internal threshold for dramatically accelerated, AI-driven research progress.

item.title: Bethesda finally names The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel in a new teaser
item.description: A short Bethesda Game Studios 40th anniversary video ended with the first new Elder Scrolls VI teaser since 2018, confirming the name Sentinel.

item.title: Claude finds Xen flaws that let one virtual machine reach the others
item.description: Xen advisory XSA-523 credits Anthropic's Claude with finding two bugs that let a malicious guest read and write other VMs' memory.

item.title: Google backs the financing for Anthropic's $19 billion Kentucky data center leases
item.description: TeraWulf signed credit support deals with Google for debt tied to about $19 billion in Anthropic leases at its Hawesville, Kentucky campus.

item.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon edges past Claude Opus 5.5 on a key AI leaderboard
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon scored 59 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, one point above Claude Opus 5.5, at lower cost per task.

item.title: Valve warns Steam game approvals are taking up to 12 business days
item.description: Valve says a big rise in submissions has slowed Steam store and build reviews, after developers reported missed launch dates.

item.title: Warner Bros.' animated The Cat in the Hat opens with split reviews
item.description: The animated Dr. Seuss film voiced by Bill Hader opens November 6, with early reviews split evenly and a $20-25 million debut forecast.

item.title: Anthropic's updated IPO filing shows about $17 billion in third-quarter revenue
item.description: An amended S-1 shows Anthropic's Q3 revenue at about $17 billion, up roughly elevenfold, with a $23.3 billion net loss.

item.title: Meta buys Conductor, an app that runs several AI coding agents at once
item.description: Meta has acquired Conductor, a startup whose app runs Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agents in parallel, for undisclosed terms.

item.title: First reviews praise Apple's OLED iPad mini ahead of Friday's launch
item.description: Reviewers say the $699 iPad mini with an 8.5-inch OLED screen and A20 Pro chip is Apple's best small tablet, though it lacks 120Hz.

item.title: Ubisoft is reported to have bid for Arkane, the studio making Marvel's Blade
item.description: Bloomberg reports Ubisoft has submitted a bid for Microsoft's Arkane, the Dishonored studio, as Xbox looks to sell it.

item.title: AMD posts a record $13.4 billion quarter and guides to about $17 billion
item.description: AMD's third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $13.4 billion, led by a record $8.5 billion from data center chips, up 97%.

item.title: Gemini uses paid subscribers' saved chats for training by default
item.description: Reports note Gemini trains on saved chats from personal accounts, including paid ones, unless users turn off Keep Activity.

item.title: Amadeus flaw exposed booking data from several Asian airlines
item.description: Travel tech firm Amadeus fixed a flaw that allowed access to airline booking data, with Japan Airlines, ANA and Cathay Pacific reporting affected customers.

item.title: Nvidia is said to require cloud partners to sell mostly to non-Chinese customers
item.description: The Financial Times reports Nvidia told cloud customers to sell at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese companies.

item.title: Noah Kahan announces a 31-date 2027 stadium tour
item.description: Noah Kahan's The Last Of The Bugs World Tour will play stadiums across North America, the UK and Europe in 2027, his biggest headline run yet.

item.title: AMD's filing puts its Taalas deal at about $2.9 billion
item.description: A securities filing shows AMD will pay about US$2.9 billion in cash and stock for AI chip startup Taalas, with US$1.4 billion contingent.

item.title: New game pages on Itch.io have doubled, but sales have not
item.description: Itch.io says new game pages per day doubled in two months, without a matching rise in downloads or purchases.

item.title: Control Resonant sells over a million copies in three weeks
item.description: Remedy says Control Resonant passed one million sales in three weeks, with about half of buyers new to the series.

item.title: Nothing says its first AI-native product ships in December
item.description: Nothing CEO Carl Pei says the company's first AI-native product arrives in December, describing it as a tool with no new screen.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches with over 1,000 new quests
item.description: Blizzard's new take on early Azeroth, World of Warcraft: Forever, left early access and fully launched on PC on November 4 with a level-60 cap.

item.title: Netflix's Matthew Perry documentary debuts at No. 1 with 9.5 million views
item.description: The One About Matthew Perry led Netflix's English TV chart for the week to November 1 with 9.5 million views and was still No. 1 in the US on November 3.

item.title: Tencent fully launches Hy4, a 770-billion-parameter open-weight model
item.description: Tencent released its Hy4 model with open weights, a 1-million-token context, and vision and computer-use skills.

item.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil passes $400 million worldwide
item.description: Sony's Resident Evil reboot has crossed $400 million worldwide and is reported to reach digital purchase and rental on November 3.

item.title: Red Hat patches a 9.8-rated Linux flaw that an AI model exploited
item.description: Red Hat has fixed CVE-2026-98432, a critical Linux kernel TCP bug, while Ubuntu's main fixes are still in testing.

item.title: Nagoshi Studio is dissolved after NetEase cuts its funding
item.description: Toshihiro Nagoshi's studio, founded after he left Sega, is listed as dissolved in Japan's government gazette.

item.title: Meta's first euro bond raises €9 billion from a record order book
item.description: Meta priced a €9 billion debut euro bond that drew a record €53 billion in orders, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero sells over 4 million copies in three days
item.description: S-GAME says its action game Phantom Blade Zero sold more than 4 million copies in 72 hours after its October 29 launch.

item.title: Lupin Part 4 leads Netflix's non-English chart with 10.8 million views
item.description: The French heist series' fourth part topped Netflix's non-English TV list for the week to November 1, with viewing hours up about 71%.

item.title: AI cloud startup Applied Compute raises $350 million at a $3.25 billion valuation
item.description: Applied Compute raised $350 million in a round led by Elad Gil, with Nvidia, Shopify Ventures and HubSpot Ventures joining.

item.title: Prime Video drops The Greatest, a scripted series about Muhammad Ali
item.description: Prime Video released all eight episodes of The Greatest, starring Jaalen Best as Muhammad Ali, on November 4.

item.title: Jailer 2 passes ₹800 crore to become the top-grossing Tamil film
item.description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has taken about ₹807 crore worldwide in 18 days, passing his own 2.0 as the biggest Tamil film ever.
